title: Ezekiel Chapter 46 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ezekiel chapter 46 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ezekiel Chapter 46 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ezekiel Chapter 46.

questions.question: In Ezekiel 46, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: The gate of the inner court shall be shut six working days
The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate
The burnt offering that the prince shall offer
The people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate
questions.correctAnswer: The gate of the inner court shall be shut six working days
questions.explanation: This event appears first as stated in Ezekiel 46:1.

questions.question: What shall be done on the sabbath according to Ezekiel 46?
options: The gate shall be opened
The prince shall leave
The burnt offering shall not be offered
The people shall not worship
questions.correctAnswer: The gate shall be opened
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:1 states that the gate shall be opened on the sabbath.

questions.question: Who shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate?
options: The priests
The people
The prince
The king
questions.correctAnswer: The prince
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:2 states that the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate.

questions.question: What offerings shall the prince prepare according to Ezekiel 46:2?
options: A grain offering and a drink offering
A burnt offering and peace offerings
A sin offering and a wave offering
A fellowship offering and a heave offering
questions.correctAnswer: A burnt offering and peace offerings
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:2 specifies that the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings.

questions.question: How many lambs shall the prince offer on the sabbath day?
options: Four lambs
Six lambs
Eight lambs
Ten lambs
questions.correctAnswer: Six lambs
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:4 states that the prince shall offer six lambs without blemish on the sabbath day.

questions.question: What is the meat offering for the lambs according to Ezekiel 46:5?
options: A bushel
An ephah
A pint
A quart
questions.correctAnswer: An ephah
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:5 states that the meat offering for the lambs shall be as he is able to give, and an ephah for a ram.

questions.question: What shall be offered on the day of the new moon according to Ezekiel 46:6?
options: A young bullock and six lambs
A goat and four lambs
A ram and two bullocks
A heifer and eight lambs
questions.correctAnswer: A young bullock and six lambs
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:6 states that on the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram.

questions.question: What shall the prince prepare as a meat offering on the new moon?
options: An ephah for a bullock
An ephah for a goat
A pint for a ram
A bushel for a lamb
questions.correctAnswer: An ephah for a bullock
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:7 states that he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock.

questions.question: How shall the prince enter and exit the gate?
options: By the way of the porch of that gate
Through the back entrance
Over the wall
By the side door
questions.correctAnswer: By the way of the porch of that gate
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:8 specifies that when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate.

questions.question: The people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate during which times?
options: Only on the new moon
Only on the sabbath
In the sabbaths and in the new moons
Every day
questions.correctAnswer: In the sabbaths and in the new moons
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:3 states that the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

questions.question: The gate shall not be shut until what time?
options: Dawn
Noon
Evening
Midnight
questions.correctAnswer: Evening
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:2 states that the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

questions.question: True or False: The gate of the inner court is open on the sabbath.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:1 states that the gate shall be opened on the sabbath.

questions.question: True or False: The prince must stand by the post of the gate.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:2 states that the prince shall stand by the post of the gate.

questions.question: True or False: The prince offers two rams on the new moon.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:6 states that the prince offers a young bullock, six lambs, and a ram, not two rams.

questions.question: True or False: The people are commanded to worship at the gate only on the weekdays.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:3 states they shall worship on the sabbaths and new moons, not only on weekdays.

medium.title: Ezekiel Chapter 46 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ezekiel Chapter 46 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:9, when the people enter the LORD's temple by the north gate during solemn feasts, how must they leave?
options: They must leave by the south gate
They must leave by the same north gate
They must leave by a side gate
They must leave by the east gate
questions.correctAnswer: They must leave by the south gate
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:9 states that he who enters by the north gate shall go out by the south gate and not return by the same gate.

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 46:10 promise will happen if the prince goes in and out with the people as described in Ezekiel 46:9?
options: The prince shall go in and go forth in the midst of them
The prince shall be separated from the people
The prince shall enter by a different gate
The prince shall not participate in the feast
questions.correctAnswer: The prince shall go in and go forth in the midst of them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:10 directly follows 46:9 and states that the prince shall go in and out among the people when they enter and leave.

questions.question: What quantity of oil is associated with the meat offering for a bullock during feasts according to Ezekiel 46:11?
options: An hin of oil to an ephah
A half hin of oil
A quarter hin of oil
No oil is mentioned
questions.correctAnswer: An hin of oil to an ephah
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:11 states the meat offering is an ephah to a bullock and an hin of oil to an ephah.

questions.question: How are the prince's voluntary burnt offerings on a feast day prepared according to Ezekiel 46:12, and how does this relate to the sabbath practice in Ezekiel 46:2?
options: The prince uses the east gate to prepare offerings as on the sabbath and then leaves and the gate is shut
The prince prepares offerings at the north gate and leaves through the south gate
The prince offers sacrifices only at the new moon
The prince must enter and leave by the same gate
questions.correctAnswer: The prince uses the east gate to prepare offerings as on the sabbath and then leaves and the gate is shut
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:12 explains the prince prepares his voluntary offerings at the east gate as he did on the sabbath (Ezekiel 46:2), then leaves and the gate is closed.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:13, what is the daily burnt offering required by the LORD?
options: A lamb of the first year without blemish
A bullock without blemish
Six lambs without blemish
A ram without blemish
questions.correctAnswer: A lamb of the first year without blemish
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:13 commands the preparation of a lamb of the first year without blemish as a daily burnt offering.

questions.question: How much fine flour and oil is used for the meat offering accompanying the daily burnt lamb, according to Ezekiel 46:14?
options: Sixth part of an ephah of flour and a third part of a hin of oil
One ephah of flour and one hin of oil
A third part of an ephah of flour and a sixth part of a hin of oil
No flour or oil is used
questions.correctAnswer: Sixth part of an ephah of flour and a third part of a hin of oil
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:14 specifies the meat offering includes the sixth part of an ephah of fine flour and the third part of a hin of oil.

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 46:15 emphasize about the preparation of the lamb, meat offering, and oil?
options: They must be prepared every morning as a continual burnt offering
They should be prepared only on sabbaths
They are optional offerings
They are to be prepared only during solemn feasts
questions.correctAnswer: They must be prepared every morning as a continual burnt offering
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:15 stresses the daily preparation of these offerings as a perpetual ordinance.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:16, what happens if the prince gives a gift of inheritance to his sons?
options: The inheritance shall be their sons' possession by inheritance
The inheritance reverts back to the prince upon his death
The inheritance is given to the priests
The inheritance is shared with the people
questions.correctAnswer: The inheritance shall be their sons' possession by inheritance
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:16 states that a gift of inheritance from the prince to his sons becomes their possession by inheritance.

questions.question: During which days is the gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shut, according to Ezekiel 46:1?
options: Six working days
Sabbath and new moon days
Only the sabbath
Always open
questions.correctAnswer: Six working days
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:1 declares the east gate is shut during the six working days and opened on sabbath and new moon days.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 46:2 describe the prince’s manner of entering and worshiping at the east gate on the sabbath?
options: He enters by the way of the porch, stands by the gatepost, worships at the threshold, then goes forth
He enters and leaves through the north gate
He offers no burnt offerings
He worships inside the temple only
questions.correctAnswer: He enters by the way of the porch, stands by the gatepost, worships at the threshold, then goes forth
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:2 describes the prince entering by the porch, standing by the gatepost, worshiping at the threshold, then departing.

questions.question: What offerings does the prince present on the sabbath according to Ezekiel 46:4?
options: Six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish
One lamb without blemish
A bullock and a ram
Only a ram
questions.correctAnswer: Six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:4 specifies the prince’s burnt offering on sabbath is six lambs and a ram, all without blemish.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:6, what animals are offered on the day of the new moon?
options: A young bullock, six lambs, and a ram, all without blemish
Only lambs
Only a bullock
No offerings on the new moon
questions.correctAnswer: A young bullock, six lambs, and a ram, all without blemish
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:6 describes the new moon offerings as a young bullock, six lambs, and a ram without blemish.

questions.question: The prince is allowed to prepare voluntary burnt offerings and peace offerings through the east gate as on the sabbath, and the gate is then shut after he leaves. This arrangement shows the importance of orderly worship and gate control.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:12 describes the prince preparing offerings at the east gate like on the sabbath and the gate being shut after he goes forth, emphasizing orderly worship.

questions.question: The prince must always enter and exit through the same gate during solemn feasts according to Ezekiel 46:9.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:9 explicitly states that those who enter by the north gate shall go out by the south gate and not return by the same gate.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:16, if the prince gives a gift to his sons, the inheritance will revert back to the prince upon his death.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:16 says the inheritance shall be the sons' possession by inheritance, not reverting back to the prince.

hard.title: Ezekiel Chapter 46 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ezekiel Chapter 46.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:17, what happens if the prince gives a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants?
options: It shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince
It becomes the servant's possession forever
It is given to the priests permanently
It is sold to the highest bidder
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:17 states that the gift of inheritance to a servant lasts only until the year of liberty, after which it returns to the prince.

questions.question: What restriction is placed on the prince regarding the people's inheritance in Ezekiel 46:18?
options: He shall not take it by oppression to thrust them out of their possession
He may take it only with the permission of the priests
He can sell it to foreign nations
He must give it to the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not take it by oppression to thrust them out of their possession
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:18 explicitly prohibits the prince from taking the people’s inheritance by oppression, to prevent scattering the people.

questions.question: In Ezekiel 46:19, where is Ezekiel brought after entering through the side gate?
options: Into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north
Into the inner court facing east
Into the outer court near the south gate
Into the temple treasury
questions.correctAnswer: Into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:19 describes the prophet being brought into the holy chambers of the priests which face north.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 46:20, what is the purpose of the place on the two sides westward in the priests' chambers?
options: To boil the trespass and sin offerings and bake the meat offering
To store the temple treasures
To house the temple musicians
To serve as a waiting area for worshipers
questions.correctAnswer: To boil the trespass and sin offerings and bake the meat offering
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:20 explains this place is designated for boiling trespass and sin offerings and baking meat offerings to avoid bringing them into the outer court.

questions.question: What structural feature is described in Ezekiel 46:21 in the utter court?
options: In every corner of the court there was a court
There was a large altar in the center
There were four pillars representing the tribes
There was a water basin for purification
questions.correctAnswer: In every corner of the court there was a court
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:21 states that in each corner of the utter court there was a smaller court, indicating a complex architectural design.

questions.question: What are the dimensions of the courts joined to the four corners of the utter court as given in Ezekiel 46:22?
options: Forty cubits long and thirty broad
Twenty cubits long and twenty broad
Fifty cubits long and forty broad
Thirty cubits long and twenty broad
questions.correctAnswer: Forty cubits long and thirty broad
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:22 describes the courts at the four corners as being forty cubits by thirty cubits in size.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word 'נַחֲלָה' (nachalah) in Ezekiel 46:17 mean?
options: Inheritance
Offering
Sanctuary
Sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: Inheritance
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'נַחֲלָה' (nachalah) used in Ezekiel 46:17 means 'inheritance' referring to property or land passed down.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in Ezekiel 46:21-22 describing the courts in the four corners?
options: Parallelism
Chiasm
Metaphor
Alliteration
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: The description in Ezekiel 46:21-22 uses parallelism by repeating similar structural details about the four courts in each corner, emphasizing uniformity.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage also emphasizes the principle that a prince should not oppress the people by taking their inheritance as in Ezekiel 46:18?
options: Leviticus 25:23
Genesis 12:1
Exodus 20:13
Numbers 6:24
questions.correctAnswer: Leviticus 25:23
questions.explanation: Leviticus 25:23 teaches that the land is God's and people have a right to their inheritance, echoing Ezekiel 46:18 which forbids the prince from oppressing the people to take their inheritance.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the theme of continual burnt offerings mentioned in Ezekiel 46:13-15?
options: Hebrews 10:11-12
John 1:29
Romans 12:1
Acts 2:38
questions.correctAnswer: Hebrews 10:11-12
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:11-12 contrasts the continual burnt offerings of the Old Testament (like those in Ezekiel 46:13-15) with Christ's single perfect sacrifice.

questions.question: What is the verse immediately preceding Ezekiel 46:17 about?
options: The prince giving a gift of inheritance to his sons
The daily burnt offering
The opening of the eastern gate on Sabbaths
The boiling of sacrifices by priests
questions.correctAnswer: The prince giving a gift of inheritance to his sons
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:16, just before verse 17, discusses the prince giving inheritance to his sons, setting the context for the regulations in verse 17.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the boiling places mentioned in Ezekiel 46:23?
options: For ministers of the house to boil the sacrifice of the people
For washing the priests' garments
For preparing holy anointing oil
For storing the grain offerings
questions.correctAnswer: For ministers of the house to boil the sacrifice of the people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:23 and 24 clarify that the boiling places are specifically for the ministers to boil the sacrifices brought by the people.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 46:20-24 foreshadow the New Testament practice of sanctification?
options: By designating specific places and procedures for offerings to sanctify the people
By commanding the use of incense in worship
By instituting a yearly day of fasting and prayer
By requiring baptism before entering the temple
questions.correctAnswer: By designating specific places and procedures for offerings to sanctify the people
questions.explanation: The careful separation of offering preparations in Ezekiel 46:20-24 serves as a typology for sanctification through ritual purification, anticipating New Testament ideas of holiness.

questions.question: What is the significance of the prince going in and out by the eastern gate as described in Ezekiel 46:2 and 8?
options: It symbolizes his role as mediator between God and the people
It shows his authority over the priests
It represents his ownership of all temple property
It indicates his exemption from sacrifices
questions.correctAnswer: It symbolizes his role as mediator between God and the people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:2 and 8 emphasize the prince’s entrance and exit through the eastern gate for offerings and worship, symbolizing his mediating role in temple worship.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 46:18 permits the prince to forcibly take the people's inheritance if he provides compensation.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:18 explicitly forbids the prince from taking the people's inheritance by oppression or thrusting them out, regardless of compensation.

theological.title: Ezekiel Chapter 46 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ezekiel Chapter 46 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ezekiel 46:1 teach about God's providence over worship times?
options: God ordains specific sacred times for worship distinct from ordinary days
God permits worship at any time without restriction
God prioritizes the Sabbath over the new moon as the only holy time
God requires all gates to remain open at all times for worship
questions.correctAnswer: God ordains specific sacred times for worship distinct from ordinary days
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:1 states that the gate shall be shut on six working days but opened on the Sabbath and new moon, showing God's providential appointment of sacred times for worship distinct from ordinary days.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ezekiel 46:4 teach about the nature of offerings required for sanctification?
options: Offerings must be without blemish to signify purity
Offerings can be imperfect as long as the heart is sincere
Offerings are symbolic and do not require physical perfection
Offerings are only necessary on feast days
questions.correctAnswer: Offerings must be without blemish to signify purity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:4 specifies six lambs and a ram without blemish, teaching the doctrine that offerings must be without defect to represent purity and holiness before God.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning leadership and worship is taught in Ezekiel 46:16?
options: The prince may grant inheritance only to his sons, preserving generational blessing
The prince may distribute land freely to servants without restriction
The prince can confiscate land from the people at will
The prince has no role in the inheritance of land
questions.correctAnswer: The prince may grant inheritance only to his sons, preserving generational blessing
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:16 states that if the prince gives a gift to his sons, it shall be their possession by inheritance, teaching the doctrine of generational continuity and blessing within leadership.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ezekiel 46:13 specifically demonstrate?
options: God's faithfulness in providing continual offerings
God's omnipotence in creating the universe
God's mercy in forgiving sins without sacrifice
God's transcendence above the temple
questions.correctAnswer: God's faithfulness in providing continual offerings
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:13 commands daily preparation of a lamb without blemish as a continual burnt offering, demonstrating God's faithfulness in sustaining a constant means of atonement and worship.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ezekiel 46:18 specifically demonstrate in the prince's conduct regarding the people's inheritance?
options: God's justice in forbidding oppression by leaders
God's wrath in punishing the prince for taking land
God's sovereignty in allowing leaders to do as they please
God's indifference to social injustice
questions.correctAnswer: God's justice in forbidding oppression by leaders
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:18 forbids the prince from taking the people's inheritance by oppression, reflecting God's attribute of justice and concern for fairness in leadership.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 46:9 prepare for the theme of orderly worship found in the New Testament?
options: By emphasizing structured movement and order in worship practices
By abolishing all ritual regulations for worship
By promoting individualistic, unscripted worship
By focusing only on sacrifices without concern for worship order
questions.correctAnswer: By emphasizing structured movement and order in worship practices
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:9 details the direction of entry and exit during solemn feasts, illustrating the importance of order and reverence in worship, a theme continued in the New Testament's teaching on orderly worship (1 Corinthians 14:40).

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 46:12 connect to the broader biblical theme of voluntary offerings in redemptive history?
options: It shows the prince's voluntary offerings as a foreshadowing of Christ's voluntary sacrifice
It teaches that only mandatory offerings please God
It negates the need for any voluntary offerings
It emphasizes that offerings must be coerced
questions.correctAnswer: It shows the prince's voluntary offerings as a foreshadowing of Christ's voluntary sacrifice
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:12 describes the prince preparing voluntary burnt offerings and peace offerings, foreshadowing Christ's voluntary sacrifice which fulfills and surpasses all Old Testament offerings (Hebrews 10:14).

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 46:14 and 46:15 teach about sanctification and continual worship?
options: Sanctification requires continual, daily offerings as a perpetual ordinance
Sanctification is achieved without any ritual or offerings
Offerings are occasional and do not impact sanctification
Daily offerings are symbolic but unnecessary for true sanctification
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification requires continual, daily offerings as a perpetual ordinance
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:14–15 prescribe daily preparation of meat offerings and lambs as a perpetual ordinance, teaching that sanctification involves continual worship and dedication to God.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 46:6 and 46:11 teach about the nature of offerings during special sacred times?
options: Offerings during new moons and feasts must be abundant and without blemish
Offerings during sacred times may be of lesser quality
Only burnt offerings are required during sacred times
Offerings are not required on sacred days
questions.correctAnswer: Offerings during new moons and feasts must be abundant and without blemish
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:6 and 46:11 specify young bullocks, lambs, rams without blemish and corresponding meat offerings with oil, emphasizing the abundance and purity required during sacred times.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 46:17 and 46:18 teach about the ethical responsibilities of leadership in relation to property and inheritance?
options: Leaders must protect people's inheritance and avoid oppression, ensuring justice
Leaders may seize property arbitrarily for their own gain
Inheritance laws are irrelevant under divine rule
Leaders should prioritize servants' inheritance over their sons'
questions.correctAnswer: Leaders must protect people's inheritance and avoid oppression, ensuring justice
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:17–18 teach that gifts of inheritance to servants revert in the year of liberty and that the prince shall not oppress the people by taking their land, highlighting leadership's ethical responsibility to justice and protection of property rights.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that Ezekiel 46:1–7 shows an arbitrary and legalistic system of worship that stifles true spirituality. What does the passage actually teach?
options: God establishes specific times and offerings to cultivate reverence and holiness in worship
The passage encourages worship without structure or regulation
It teaches that only external rituals matter, not the heart
The passage abolishes the need for any offerings
questions.correctAnswer: God establishes specific times and offerings to cultivate reverence and holiness in worship
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:1–7 details divinely ordained times and offerings, showing that God prescribes order and holiness in worship rather than arbitrary legalism.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ezekiel 46:19 teach about the sacredness and separation of priestly ministry?
options: Priests have designated holy chambers separate from common areas to maintain sanctity
Priests are to minister in the common courts alongside the people
There is no distinction between priests and laity in ministry spaces
Priests should minister only outside the temple complex
questions.correctAnswer: Priests have designated holy chambers separate from common areas to maintain sanctity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:19 describes the holy chambers for priests set apart, teaching the doctrine of sacred space dedicated to priestly functions to maintain holiness.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ezekiel 46:22 demonstrate through the precise measurements of the temple courts?
options: God's orderliness and perfection in design
God's hiddenness and mystery
God's indifference to human worship
God's capriciousness in temple structure
questions.correctAnswer: God's orderliness and perfection in design
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:22 details courts of exact measurements, reflecting God's attribute of order and perfection in the design of worship spaces.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 46:20–21 connect to the broader biblical theme of purity in sacrificial worship?
options: By designating special places for priests to boil and bake offerings to avoid defiling the people
By allowing offerings to be handled anywhere in the temple complex
By minimizing the importance of sacrifice preparation
By forbidding priests to handle offerings
questions.correctAnswer: By designating special places for priests to boil and bake offerings to avoid defiling the people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:20–21 establishes holy chambers for priests to prepare offerings, emphasizing purity and separation in sacrificial worship consistent with biblical holiness codes.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 46:23 and 46:24 teach about the role of temple ministers in worship practice?
options: Ministers have practical responsibilities to prepare sacrifices, ensuring ritual purity
Ministers' roles are purely ceremonial without practical duties
Ministers are only responsible for teaching, not sacrificial duties
Ministers may neglect the preparation of offerings
questions.correctAnswer: Ministers have practical responsibilities to prepare sacrifices, ensuring ritual purity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 46:23–24 describe buildings with boiling places for ministers to prepare sacrifices, teaching that ministers have essential practical roles in worship preparation and ritual purity.
